bills.title: Universities Accord (Student Support and Other Measures) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-11-26.261.1) introduced by NSW Senator [Mehreen Faruqi](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/nsw/mehreen_faruqi) (Greens) to an [original motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-11-26.260.1) introduced by Queensland Senator [Anthony Chisholm](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/anthony_chisholm) (Labor), which means it failed. ### Original motion text > *That the report of the committee be adopted.* ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add "and the Senate calls on the Government to immediately legislate its pledges to raise the minimum repayment threshold for all student debt and introduce a marginal repayment system".*
question: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-11-26.261.1) introduced by NSW Senator [Mehreen Faruqi](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/nsw/mehreen_faruqi) (Greens) to an [original motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-11-26.260.1) introduced by Queensland Senator [Anthony Chisholm](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/anthony_chisholm) (Labor), which means it failed. ### Original motion text > *That the report of the committee be adopted.* ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add "and the Senate calls on the Government to immediately legislate its pledges to raise the minimum repayment threshold for all student debt and introduce a marginal repayment system".*
